name: trace_id
description: W3C 32-hex trace identifier.

name: trace_owner_app_id
description: Owning application ID (gateway caller_app_id precedence over shared proxy root; NULL when unregistered).

name: app_identity_bound
description: TRUE when owner span arrived in its registered landing place; FALSE on mismatch; NULL when trace_owner_app_id is NULL.

name: unregistered_app
description: TRUE when no app_registry entry matched the trace owner.

name: owner
description: Owning team or principal from SCD-2 app_registry.

name: business_unit
description: Business unit from SCD-2 app_registry (mapped to '__unowned__' in the restricted caller filter when NULL).

name: environment
description: Deployment environment from SCD-2 app_registry.

name: risk_tier
description: Risk tier (RL-1..RL-5) from SCD-2 app_registry.

name: barrier_domain
description: Information-barrier clearance domain from SCD-2 app_registry.

name: participating_app_count
description: Count of distinct resolved app_id values across the trace's spans (0 when none resolved).

name: root_span_id
description: Span ID of the earliest application-emitted span (skipping cloud-runtime spans; NULL when has_root_span is FALSE).

name: has_root_span
description: TRUE when at least one application-emitted span is stored for the trace.

name: is_turn
description: TRUE when the trace holds at least one agent, model-call, or tool-call span.

name: root_status
description: Normalized span_status (OK, ERROR, UNSET) of root_span_id (NULL when has_root_span is FALSE).

name: trace_start_time
description: Earliest stored span start_time in the trace (window-membership and SLA clock timestamp).

name: trace_start_writer
description: Writer of the earliest stored span: runtime or application.

name: trace_end_time
description: Latest stored span end_time in the trace.

name: last_span_arrival_time
description: Latest receive_time across stored spans in the trace.

name: missing_parent_count
description: Count of non-SERVER, non-CONSUMER spans whose parent_span_id is non-null and absent from the trace (0 when none).

name: entry_parent_outside
description: TRUE when root_span_id has a non-null parent_span_id absent from the store; NULL when has_root_span is FALSE.

name: exceeds_read_margin
description: TRUE when trace_end_time minus trace_start_time exceeds the deployment read margin.

name: sampling_probability
description: Sampling probability from W3C trace_state else root bq_eval.sampling_probability (missing stays NULL, never 1.0).

name: trigger_principal
description: bq_eval.trigger_principal resolved with gateway -> root -> earliest-span precedence.

name: agent_principal
description: bq_eval.agent_principal resolved with gateway -> root -> earliest-span precedence.

name: act_chain
description: Ordered multi-hop delegation chain JSON array (restricted only).

name: user_id
description: Requester user.id on root_span_id (restricted only).

name: user_id_source
description: Writer class (platform or application) of the span supplying user_id (NULL when user_id is NULL).

name: user_id_conflict_count
description: Count of spans in the trace carrying a non-null user.id different from user_id (0 when none).

name: tenant_id
description: bq_eval.tenant_id resolved with gateway -> root -> earliest-span precedence (restricted only).

name: identity_attested
description: TRUE when user_id came from a platform-class span, FALSE when application-emitted, NULL when user_id is NULL.

name: auth_method
description: bq_eval.auth_method resolved from platform gateway/proxy else root span.

name: issuer
description: bq_eval.auth_issuer token issuer.

name: aud
description: bq_eval.auth_audience RFC 8787 target audience.

name: delegation_chain_hash
description: bq_eval.delegation_chain_hash OBO delegation digest.

name: conversation_id
description: gen_ai.conversation.id resolved with gateway -> root -> earliest-span precedence.

name: outcome_id
description: Earliest non-null primary outcome.id on the trace's spans.

name: multiple_outcome_ids
description: TRUE when spans in the trace carry more than one distinct primary outcome.id.

name: workspace_session_id
description: bq_eval.workspace_session_id on the root or earliest span.

name: previous_interaction_id
description: bq_eval.previous_interaction_id resolved with root -> earliest-model-call precedence.

name: state_mode
description: bq_eval.state_mode resolved with gateway -> root -> earliest-span precedence.

name: runtime_lane
description: bq_eval.runtime_lane resolved with gateway -> root -> earliest-span precedence.

name: shadow_of_trace_id
description: bq_eval.shadow_of_trace_id on root_span_id.

name: experiment_id
description: bq_eval.experiment_id on root_span_id.

name: variant_id
description: bq_eval.variant_id on root_span_id.

name: case_id
description: bq_eval.case_id on root_span_id.

name: eval_run_id
description: bq_eval.eval_run_id on root_span_id.

name: eval_split
description: bq_eval.eval_split (train or holdout) on root_span_id.

name: skill_sha256
description: Primary bq_eval.skill_sha256 resolved with root -> earliest-call precedence.

name: protected_block_sha256
description: Emitted bq_eval.protected_block_sha256 compared downstream against skill_registry.

name: mounted_skills
description: bq_eval.mounted_skills JSON array (NULL when absent, distinct from []).

name: unregistered_skill
description: TRUE when a named skill on the trace has no active skill_registry row.

name: tool_definitions_sha256
description: bq_eval.tool_definitions_sha256 resolved with root -> earliest-model-call precedence.

name: page_count
description: bq_eval.document.page_count resolved with gateway -> root -> max-call precedence.

name: document_bytes
description: bq_eval.document.bytes resolved with gateway -> root -> max-call precedence.

name: attachment_sha256
description: bq_eval.attachment_sha256 file hex digest (restricted only).

name: final_model_confidence
description: model_confidence of the latest model call (by end_time, span_id) reporting confidence.

name: escalated
description: TRUE when any model call in the trace has cascade_tier = 'escalation' or an outcome.escalated event references the trace.

name: app_failed
description: TRUE when any span in the trace emitted bq_eval.app_failed = true; FALSE otherwise.

name: app_failure_reason
description: Earliest bq_eval.app_failure_reason string on the trace (restricted only).

name: traffic_type
description: bq_eval.traffic_type resolved with gateway -> root -> earliest-call precedence.

name: span_count
description: Count of deduplicated spans in the trace.

name: model_call_count
description: Count of model_calls rows (innermost positive-token and model/embedding calls) in the trace (0 when none).

name: tool_call_count
description: Count of folded tool_calls rows in the trace (0 when none).

name: mutating_tool_call_count
description: Count of tool calls whose tool has writes_state = true (0 when none).

name: workspace_edit_count
description: Count of tool calls whose tool has modifies_workspace = true (0 when none).

name: unregistered_tool_count
description: Count of tool calls with no matching tools registry entry (0 when none).

name: guardrail_intervention_count
description: Count of guardrail.intervention records tied to the trace (0 when none).

name: content_missing_call_count
description: Count of model and tool calls in the trace with content_missing = true (0 when none).

name: user_turn_count
description: Count of user-turn boundary prompts in the trace (0 when is_turn is FALSE; 1 on content-missing turns).

name: duplicate_span_count
description: Sum of duplicate_count across spans in the trace (0 when none).

name: repeated_tool_call_count
description: Count of tool calls in the trace repeating an earlier (tool_name, args_sha256) pair (0 when none).

name: error_count
description: Count of spans in the trace with span_status = 'ERROR' or non-null error_type (0 when none).

name: throttle_count
description: Count of spans in the trace with http_status_code = 429 (0 when none).

name: missing_user_id_span_count
description: Count of application spans in the trace without user.id (0 when none).

name: missing_outcome_id_span_count
description: Count of application spans in the trace without outcome.id (0 when none).

name: missing_conversation_id_span_count
description: Count of application spans in the trace without conversation_id (0 when none).

name: input_tokens
description: Sum of input_tokens across model_calls in the trace (NULL when model_call_count = 0).

name: output_tokens
description: Sum of output_tokens across model_calls in the trace (NULL when model_call_count = 0).

name: cache_read_input_tokens
description: Sum of cache_read_tokens across model_calls in the trace (NULL when model_call_count = 0).

name: cache_write_input_tokens
description: Sum of cache_write_tokens across model_calls in the trace (NULL when model_call_count = 0).

name: reasoning_output_tokens
description: Sum of reasoning_tokens across model_calls in the trace (NULL when model_call_count = 0).

name: labels
description: Registered slice-only attributes JSON object.
